member.name: T:Mfr.Metadata.AudioTagPersistence
member.summary: Loads and saves structured field blocks via TagLibSharp across supported formats.

remarks.para: Call only when the rename row’s embedded-tag preview differs from its original snapshot; compare outside this type (for example in CommitExecutor) before calling. That Apply overload diffs Original → Preview per tag block: remove dropped types, create new blocks, and field-patch only changed modeled fields (unmodeled frames such as APIC stay unless the whole type is removed).

Overlay blocks hold parsed fields (not binary blobs). There is no merged file.Tag dual write. Which fields a block models, and how they are read and patched, lives in the matching *TagFields class (for example ); this type only decides which blocks to visit.
A preview may not introduce a tag block the container cannot hold; see .
